title: Thousands Protest Against Flávio Bolsonaro Ahead of Election Runoff
detail: Thousands of demonstrators took to the streets across Brazil to protest against Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the presidential election runoff, voicing fears of a far-right political return. The protests reflect deep divisions in Brazilian society as the country prepares for the second round of voting.

media.caption: Protesters rally against Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Brazil's election runoff
